title: 第21章 预防鼠疫第22章 暖床
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：巴克有些圆润的小眼睛猛地一缩：“难不成是那些很漂亮的二层小院？”
叶海送他的房产正是之前那些琉璃川骑士们购买的同款。
“没错。”
叶海很是自然的回道。
送一栋房子而已，这点开销对他来说根本不算什么。
更何况整个枫叶领都是叶海这位枫叶伯爵的，地皮等于零成本，叶海送起来就更不心疼了。
其他人想要建房都得先找叶海这个领主先买地，然后才能在上面建房。
而叶海不仅不用掏这个钱，还能在卖房的时候把地皮的价值加上去，这一来一回等他赚两次。
“天呐，那可是要好几十个金币，我打十年铁都不一定能攒下那么多钱。”
巴克圆溜溜的小眼睛瞪大，语气中充斥着兴奋。
虽然说他在城里是个非常有名气的铁匠，年收入都是按金币来计算的，可他平常的花销也大，手底下有七八个学徒跟着他混饭吃。
虽然学徒不用给工资，但光是管饭就是一笔不小的开销了。
更何况他本人还爱喝酒，便宜的还不喝，就爱挑贵的买。
这就导致了他的家底其实一直都不厚，即使此前在行政大厅发售房产的时候十分心动，也掏不出钱来买。
“那现在你不用攒了，留着钱继续买酒去喝吧。”
叶海微微一笑，他最喜欢看到底下的这些人把钱花在消费上了，这样才能拉动领地内的商业发展。
巴克兴奋的搓了搓手，从叶海手中接过地契和钥匙：“那我就不客气了，多谢伯爵大人，我一定会用最快的速度将您想要的东西制作出来。”
叶海听到巴克的表态满意的点了点头，要的就是这个效果。
花一点点小钱，让手底下的人积极性大幅度提高。
尤其是这些关键位置的人，他们的主观能动性非常重要。
离开工厂之后，叶海没有急着踏上返程，而是骑着马沿着河流的方向漫步。
月光洒在他亮银色的盔甲上，显得有些冷冽。
他微微勒紧缰绳，战马稳稳地踏着河岸的青石小径：“征召辅兵的命令传下去了没有。”
佛丁应道：“我已经让人快马连夜将命令传递到各个小镇去了，届时他们会再派人到下面的村庄下达命令。”
“枫叶城内应该明天白天就会有来服役的自由民，小镇和各个村庄过来服役的自由民应该会在接下来的一至两周内陆续到位。”
按照帝国的法律，每当领主要发动战争时，都可以向所有封臣和自由民发出召唤。
而受召者也必须自带武器、马匹、铠甲、仆从、干粮为他效忠的对象提供四十天的免费兵役。
如果超过四十天，则需要领主提供额外的薪水。
不过实际上这些自由民压根就没什么武器，更别提马匹和铠甲了。
他们最多就是拎着个木棍带些干粮就来了。
所以在多数情况下，他们只能作为辅兵使用。
只有一些穷到养不起常备军的小贵族小领主才会将这些临时征召来的自由民当主力军使用。
叶海微微颔首：“这次要面对的敌人比较特殊，所以这些辅兵也得严加管理，不能让他们乱来。”
content_en:
: Buck's round little eyes suddenly shrank: "Could it be those beautiful two-story courtyards?"
The property Ye Hai gave him was the same property that the Liulicuan knights had purchased before.
"That's right."
Ye Hai replied very naturally.
It was just a gift of a house, and this expense was nothing to him.
What's more, the entire Maple Leaf Territory belongs to Ye Hai, the Maple Leaf Earl, and the land cost is zero, so Ye Hai feels less distressed when giving it away.
Anyone else who wanted to build a house had to go to Ye Hai, the lord, to buy land first, and then build a house on it.
Not only does Ye Hai not have to pay this money, but he can also add the value of the land when selling the house, making him twice as much money this time.
"Oh my god, that's dozens of gold coins. I may not be able to save that much money even if I've been working hard for ten years."
Buck's round little eyes widened, and his tone was full of excitement.
Although he is a very famous blacksmith in the city, and his annual income is calculated in gold coins, his daily expenses are also high, and he has seven or eight apprentices who work with him to earn a living.
Although apprentices do not need to be paid a salary, just taking care of the food is a considerable expense.
What's more, he himself likes to drink. If he doesn't drink the cheap ones, he likes to buy the expensive ones.
This led to the fact that his family has never been rich. Even though he was very excited when the real estate was sold in the administrative hall, he could not afford to buy it.
"Then you don't have to save now, just keep the money to buy wine and drink."
Ye Hai smiled slightly. He liked to see the people below spending money on consumption, so as to stimulate the commercial development in the territory.
Buck rubbed his hands excitedly and took the land deed and key from Ye Hai: "Then I'm welcome. Thank you, Lord Earl. I will definitely make what you want as quickly as possible."
Ye Hai nodded with satisfaction after hearing Buck's statement. This was the effect he wanted.
Spend a little money to greatly increase the motivation of the people under your control.
Especially for people in these key positions, their subjective initiative is very important.
…
After leaving the factory, Ye Hai was not in a hurry to return, but instead rode a horse and strolled along the river.
The moonlight shone on his bright silver armor, making it look a bit cold.
He tightened the reins slightly, and the horse stepped steadily on the bluestone path on the river bank: "Has the order to recruit auxiliary troops been passed on?"
Fording responded: "I have already sent people to deliver the order to various small towns overnight. At that time, they will send people to the villages below to issue the order."
"There should be freedmen coming to serve in Maple Leaf City during the day tomorrow, and freedmen coming to serve in small towns and villages should be arriving in the next one to two weeks."
According to the laws of the empire, whenever a lord wants to start a war, he can issue a summons to all vassals and free people.
The callee must also bring his own weapons, horses, armor, servants, and dry food to provide forty days of free military service to the person he is loyal to.
If it exceeds forty days, the lord will need to provide additional salary.
But in fact, these free people had no weapons at all, let alone horses and armor.
At most, they just came with a wooden stick and some dry food.
Therefore, in most cases, they can only be used as auxiliary soldiers.
Only some small nobles and small lords who are too poor to support a standing army will use these temporarily recruited free people as the main force.
"Yeah."
Ye Hai nodded slightly: "The enemies we have to face this time are quite special, so these auxiliary soldiers must be strictly managed and they cannot be allowed to act randomly."
